responses.argument: I withdraw publisher authorization specifically for geodata as a mandatory engineering acceptance gate. The evidence did not establish that authorization is the sole possible legal basis, and applying a special gate to geodata was inconsistent with leaving other client-derived artifacts as unresolved risks. Accept one project-wide register with artifact-specific provenance, applicable terms, distribution details, and unresolved questions. However, the artifacts do not automatically have identical legal status, and owner risk acceptance does not create rights. Local generation establishes reproducibility, not legal clearance. Engineering can proceed without claiming clearance; the register must exist during hobby work as well as inform the public-launch decision.

summary: Architectural consensus reached on the complete H5 project. All critical and major engineering disagreements are resolved by the adopted transaction, identity, perception, authority, UI, testing, and operational designs. I withdraw the special geodata authorization gate and mandatory hobby endpoint-concealment gateway. Legal clearance, owner risk acceptance, client compatibility, and capacity remain explicitly unproven acceptance matters, not claimed results. Mobius references are relative to the checkout identified in 01_VERIFIED_FACTS.md at commit 2b0758e97d5a097127b7330ee59e82d4b1d69b3b.
